description: Bellard's Quill (벨라드의 깃펜): a long dark-grey quill pen with a silver nib stained with old ink, lying across a single folded sheet of paper that is sealed with plain grey wax (no symbol on the seal), a faint cold-blue glow along the feather.
The Dawn Ring (새벽의 반지): a simple gold ring set with one small pale stone that glows like the first light of dawn, warm orange-gold light spilling from it, resting on a little heap of grey ash.
